deploybot: [AUTOPAUSE] Scheduled release slot 03:30 PT for release v3.5.2 paused due to incident INC-2026-147 (eu-control-plane ingress spike). Holding slot and notifying owners. If you need to force-run, use /deploy override with 2FA.

maria: ack, oncall. Investigating ingress spike now. Not seeing errors in pods yet, getting logs.

josh: Thx. Are we considering rollback or moving to warm-standby slot? We'd prefer to avoid rollback if it's non-customer-facing.

sre_lead: What's the impact? Any 5xx from customers?

maria: Early metrics: a 12% increase in 503s from EU edge for ~5m, some retries. Not widespread yet. Traces point to cp-k8s-ingress hitting CPU throttling.

ops_pager: Suggests hold and gap-fill: postpone to next guarded slot at 06:00 PT and re-run canary subset 10% before full rollout. Can we free the slot?

josh: sounds reasonable. Can we also pin the release to v3.5.2-rc1 for the warmback? Need to ensure no auto-fastfollow.

maria: I'll pin in the release-orchestrator: `roctl pin release v3.5.2-rc1 --slot 06:00PT --note "post-INC-2026-147 warmback"`

deploybot: Action logged: release pinned by maria. Slot 03:30 marked deferred -> 06:00. Canary planned: 10% for 10m, then 50% for 10m. Rollback policy: auto-rollback if error-rate > 2% above baseline for 5m.

sre_lead: Also add a precautionary kernel patch to the cp nodes? Ops, can you coordinate a small rolling restart of ingress-controller with a drain window aligned to the deferred slot?

ops_pager: I'll schedule ingress restarts starting @04:15 PT, one zone at a time. That should clear CPU hot loops and give us a clean warmback.

josh: Update release notes to mention the deferred slot and the canary gating. I'll draft a quick blurb.

josh: `Release notes snippet: "Deployment deferred from 03:30PT due to regional control-plane ingress spike (INC-2026-147). Canary will run at 06:00PT with automated rollback gating. No customer-facing changes expected."`

maria: I'll keep monitoring and post another update at 05:40 PT. If anything changes, we re-evaluate.

ops_pager: +1. Will update incident ticket and notify support channel.

deploybot: Closing automation loop. Slot requeue scheduled for 06:00 PT. Remind channel at 05:50 PT. :thumbsup:
